title: Night-time heart attack, Laamu
story: 21:00, Isdhoo (Laamu). 58-year-old fisherman with crushing chest pain for 40 minutes, sweating, pain going to the left arm.
proves: Seaplane infeasible at night; sea ambulance to Malé breaches the 120-min PCI window, so the engine recommends speedboat to Gan Regional for fibrinolysis + fixed-wing Kadhdhoo → Hulhulé → IGMH for PCI.
intake_text: My father has crushing chest pain for 40 minutes, he is sweating a lot and the pain is going to his left arm. He is 58, a fisherman.

steps.note: Accept for primary PCI. Fibrinolysis at Gan agreed.

presenter_notes: Open /report on the phone, then /hospital and /transport. Press Day 14:00 in /demo to show the seaplane becoming feasible.
